=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Courier is identified by CourierId.
CourierId is a value of type Integer.
CourierName is a value of type String.
Depot is identified by DepotCode.
DepotCode is a value of type String.
Parcel is identified by ParcelCode.
ParcelCode is a value of type String.
Route is identified by RouteName.
RouteName is a value of type String.
Delivery is identified by the combination of parcel (in fact type delivery_of_parcel) and route (in fact type delivery_on_route).
WeightKg is a value of type Integer.
StopCount is a value of type Integer.
ParcelStatus is a value of type String.

=== Fact Types ===
Courier has CourierName
  - courier: Courier (Integer)
  - name: CourierName (String)

Courier is based at Depot
  - courier: Courier (Integer)
  - depot: Depot (String)

Route starts at Depot
  - route: Route (String)
  - depot: Depot (String)

Courier drives Route
  - courier: Courier (Integer)
  - route: Route (String)

Parcel weighs WeightKg
  - parcel: Parcel (String)
  - weight: WeightKg (Integer)

Parcel has ParcelStatus
  - parcel: Parcel (String)
  - status: ParcelStatus (String)

Delivery is of Parcel
  - delivery: Delivery
  - parcel: Parcel (String)

Delivery is on Route
  - delivery: Delivery
  - route: Route (String)

Delivery is handled by Courier
  - delivery: Delivery
  - courier: Courier (Integer)

Delivery made StopCount stops
  - delivery: Delivery
  - stops: StopCount (Integer)

Courier is on shift
  - courier: Courier (Integer)

Courier is off duty
  - courier: Courier (Integer)
